comments.author: @harrytpk
comments.text: Every single episode ends up with a lecture on Climate Change, I’m an old man, 77 years old, for at least the last 50 years I’ve been hearing about climate change, the crisis always right around the corner, the crisis that never actually gets here, I’ll be dead soon and I’ll die without ever seeing it, I wonder when Jeff is 77 if he will see it, or will he still be warning about climate change? Will climate change ever happen? Yes it will, even if man never existed the climate will change. The Earth goes on with us or without us, planet earth has no dog in that fight.
